title: Candy Royale
features: Symbols pay ANYWHERE: land 8 or more of the same symbol on the 6x5 grid to win.
TUMBLE: winning symbols burst, the rest fall down and new ones drop in — keep winning until nothing pays.
SCATTER: 4 or more anywhere pay up to 100x the total bet and award 10 FREE SPINS. 3 or more during free spins award 5 more.
RAINBOW BOMBS land only in free spins and carry a 2x–100x multiplier. When a tumble sequence ends with a win, all bombs on the grid are added up and multiply the win.
